## Question 1

install.packages("aRtsy")

Install.packages is how you download a package from a repo and you only have to do it once. When you library something it loads it into the current section. That is something you have to do every R session.

# Packages

## Question 2

```{r}
library(aRtsy)
```

The Collatz conjecture is a famous mathematics problem that is unsolved. It states that no matter what positive integer you start with, this sequence will always eventually reach 1.

$f(n) = \begin{cases} n/2 & \text{if } n \equiv 0 \pmod{2} \\ 3n + 1 & \text{if } n \equiv 1 \pmod{2} \end{cases}$
